body: ITC is available only if the recipient holds a tax invoice or debit note, the supplier has paid the tax to the government, and the goods or services were received.
ITC is blocked on goods or services used for personal consumption, and on certain categories listed as blocked credits.
ITC is available only to the extent of invoices or debit notes that appear in the recipient's GSTR-2B for the period.
If the supplier is not paid within 180 days of the invoice date, the ITC claimed must be reversed with interest.
Credit must be reversed proportionately for inputs used in both taxable and exempt supplies.
Clarifies ITC matching against GSTR-2B and the treatment of differences in invoice details.
